methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: An unoccupied house under real weather conditions has been used to test the proposed method.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The test case considered is the second experiment conducted by Fraunhofer Institute in Holzkirchen (near Munich, Germany) on the twin house O5 during April and May 2014.
